arguments.sql: SELECT rule_id, rule, tolerance FROM reconciliation_rules
/* R01 资产 = 负债 + 所有者权益 */ SELECT report_date, diff FROM check_r01 WHERE fiscal_year BETWEEN 2023 AND 2025
/* R02 流动资产 + 非流动资产 = 资产总计 */ SELECT report_date, diff FROM check_r02 WHERE fiscal_year BETWEEN 2023 AND 2025
/* R03 流动负债 + 非流动负债 = 负债合计 */ SELECT report_date, diff FROM check_r03 WHERE fiscal_year BETWEEN 2023 AND 2025
/* R04 营业收入 − 营业成本 − 各项费用 = 营业利润（允许其他收益） */ SELECT report_date, diff FROM check_r04 WHERE fiscal_year BETWEEN 2023 AND 2025
/* R05 利润总额 − 所得税 = 净利润 */ SELECT report_date, diff FROM check_r05 WHERE fiscal_year BETWEEN 2023 AND 2025
/* R06 归母净利润 + 少数股东损益 = 净利润 */ SELECT report_date, diff FROM check_r06 WHERE fiscal_year BETWEEN 2023 AND 2025
/* R07 经营 + 投资 + 筹资现金流 + 汇率影响 = 现金净增加额 */ SELECT report_date, diff FROM check_r07 WHERE fiscal_year BETWEEN 2023 AND 2025
/* R08 期初现金 + 现金净增加额 = 期末现金 */ SELECT report_date, diff FROM check_r08 WHERE fiscal_year BETWEEN 2023 AND 2025
/* R09 利润表净利润 = 现金流量表补充资料里的净利润 */ SELECT report_date, diff FROM check_r09 WHERE fiscal_year BETWEEN 2023 AND 2025
